answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 20919 Country: Pakistan Title: i have 02 questions regarding zakat. 1) i have a plot which i took with the intention of selling and obtaining profit when its value will go high. Is there any zakat on this plot? or will i pay zakat once it will be sold? 2) i have a furnished property which i have rented out as office to one organization. Is there any zakat on this property or just on its rental amount. Please reply both questions separetly. Question: Mufti sahab AOA, i have 02 questions regarding zakat. 1) i have a plot which i took with the intention of selling and obtaining profit when its value will go high. Is there any zakat on this plot? or will i pay zakat once it will be sold? 2) i have a furnished property which i have rented out as office to one organization. Is there any zakat on this property or just on its rental amount. Please reply both questions separetly. Thank you. Answer ID: 20919 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 521/374/D=1431) (1) Yes, it is wajib to pay zakah of its present value each year. (2) If the amount of rent is deposited with you then zakah shall be wajib on the total amount after passing of one year. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
